Analytical Expression for {log log log log N}
==================================================

N = pi^(pi^(pi^pi))

log N = pi^(pi^pi) * ln pi
log log N = log(pi^(pi^pi) * ln pi) = pi^pi * ln pi + ln(ln pi)
log log log N = log(pi^pi * ln pi + ln(ln pi))
log log log log N = log(log(pi^pi * ln pi + ln(ln pi)))

Let L1 = ln pi
Let L2 = pi^pi * ln pi + ln(ln pi)
Let L3 = log(L2)
Then {log log log log N} = {log(L3)} = log(L3) - floor(log(L3))

Exact expression:
{log log log log pi^(pi^(pi^pi))} = log(log(pi^pi * log pi + log(log pi))) - floor(log(log(pi^pi * log pi + log(log pi))))
approx 0.3176613010072958359625235748034351589114130136729285749944763870770217554622916292766283588766326214...

Since 0 < {log log log log N} < 1 and {log log log log N} != 0,
log log log log N not in Z
Therefore log log log N is not an integer power of e
Therefore log log N is not an integer power of e
Therefore log N is not an integer power of e
Therefore N = pi^(pi^(pi^pi)) is not an integer power of e
Since e is transcendental and pi is transcendental, N not in Z. QED.
